Description: The post shows a blurry video still of an armored vehicle. The caption makes extreme, secessionist claims: "INDIAN ARMY RUNNING OUT OF MANIPUR," alleging troops "illegally entering" Manipur were kicked out by locals, and explicitly concluding with the demand to "FREE MANIPUR."

IT Act and Rules: This is a critical violation of Rule 3(1)(b)(vii). A foreign network explicitly advocating for the secession of a state ("FREE MANIPUR") while simultaneously framing the national army as an illegal, fleeing occupation force is a direct, hostile attack on the sovereignty and territorial integrity of the nation.

BNS & Other Laws: Section 152 (Act endangering sovereignty) and Section 353 (Statements conducing to public mischief).

Take Down: Expedited Standard Takedown. Foreign information operations explicitly advocating for secession require rapid network-level neutralization.
